in_flight_work.why: This lane established that clean_oss_candidates conflates runnable products with primitives (e_sign: 3 clean rows are all PDF-signing libraries; all four full products are AGPL). Until every kind is split, the commodity count overstates usable supply.

judgement_calls.subagent_proposed: portal -> notes_docs (to avoid leaving the row kindless)
judgement_calls.lane_owner_decided: portal -> developer_docs_rendering, disposition dropped to reference
judgement_calls.why: notes_docs in this taxonomy means Notion-like AUTHORING. Redoc renders a machine-generated OpenAPI spec to static HTML; no one authors in it. Counting it as notes_docs supply would inflate that kind with a row that cannot serve the capability — the exact inflation failure this pass exists to correct. developer_docs_rendering sits outside the 24-kind client-capability taxonomy and is excluded from classification, so a developer-facing kind with no supply is never read as a client supply gap.
judgement_calls.effect: notes_docs 24 -> 23; subagent flagged this as the one call worth overturning and it was right to flag it.

judgement_calls.why: The subagent's own evidence string disqualified its verdict: 'a signing-authority/HSM service, not a DocuSign-class signer-workflow app... no document-sending workflow'. Deployable infrastructure is not a product for the capability it is tagged with — no signer identity, no document routing, no audit surface.
